message.title: Heartfelt Wishes
message.p1:
On this special day,
thank you for being born.
message.p2:
Your presence makes
this world brighter
and warmer.
message.p3:
May the year ahead
be filled with
smiles and happiness.

wishes.label: Health & Peace
wishes.desc:
May every day
be healthy and serene

wishes.label: Dreams Come True
wishes.desc:
May the future you envision
unfold step by step

wishes.label: Beautiful Encounters
wishes.desc:
May wonderful connections
grow around you

moment1.text: The beginning of a new year
